title: Refactor and implement core generator system
body:
Rebuild the generator logic for modularity and support for future engines. Acceptance criteria:
- Modular source structure (per-engine)
- Passes integration tests
- Linked to 'Agent Mode Launch' milestone.

title: Integrate unified social publishing endpoints
body:
Wire the API and frontend for instant publishing to Instagram, YouTube, X/Twitter, and TikTok. Tracks status, handles retries, and shows per-platform results.
Acceptance:
- Works with 'Publish to All' in UI
- Status codes handled and errors surfaced
- CI test coverage exists

title: Harden Stripe/Coinbase webhook and entitlements logic
body:
Add validation for all payment webhooks. Ensure new subscriptions and upgrades grant correct permissions. Acceptance:
- Webhook signature tests
- Permissions and limits enforced per tier
- Docs in README.deploy.md

title: Add dashboard analytics for generator and publishing usage
body:
Implement real-time and historical analytics dashboard. K-Factor, referral, and sentiment analytics visualized. Acceptance:
- Live metrics data in dashboard
- Trend sparkline for 14 days
- Data export works

title: Set up team collaboration features (comments, roles, approvals)
body:
Enable multi-user collaboration with roles, comments, approvals, and notifications. Acceptance:
- Org role assignment in UI
- Comments visible and editable
- Approval flow triggers notifications
